mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_translation_cache ( content_type, content_id, source_field, target_language, source_hash, detected_source_language, translated_text, provider, status, lease_token, lease_expires_at, retry_after, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{sourceField}, #{targetLanguage}, #{sourceHash}, #{detectedSourceLanguage}, #{translatedText}, #{provider}, 'READY', NULL, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_hash = #{sourceHash}, detected_source_language = #{detectedSourceLanguage}, translated_text = #{translatedText}, provider = #{provider}, status = 'READY', lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, retry_after = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT id, content_type, content_id, source_field, target_language, source_hash, detected_source_language, translated_text, provider, status, lease_token, lease_expires_at, retry_after, created_at, updated_at FROM content_translation_cache WHERE status = 'READY' AND translated_text IS NOT NULL AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
